issues.title: Ingest Scott County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $12,584,614 across 53 funds. The largest: County Road Department ($3,149,115), County General Fund ($3,086,601), Jail ($1,597,738). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
